headline: PM visit to China planned for this month
summary: The Prime Minister is scheduled to travel to China within the current month to strengthen bilateral ties.
details: The Prime Minister of Bangladesh is set to visit China this month, according to reports.
The visit is expected to focus on strengthening bilateral relations and discussing key strategic partnerships.
China and Bangladesh have long maintained a strong diplomatic and economic relationship, with China providing significant investment in infrastructure projects.
Further details regarding the official itinerary and the specific meetings scheduled during the trip are awaited.

headline: Major Police reshuffle announced in Bangladesh
summary: A significant reorganization of personnel within the police force has been taken place.
details: The Bangladesh Police has undergone a major reshuffle of its officers and personnel.
This reorganization is part of a broader effort to streamline operations and improve efficiency within the law enforcement agency.
The official order regarding the transfers and postings of various officers has been released.
Such reshuffles are common in the police force to maintain administrative discipline and operational effectiveness.
